recipes.name: Roasted Bell Pepper Pesto Sandwich
instructions: Add the tofu, cornstarch, and salt to a bowl and gently massage to coat.
Add oil to a non-stick large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu until golden, about 5 minutes per side.
Spread the hummus and pesto on the toasted bread.
Add the spinach, bell pepper, tofu, and avocado. Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and pepper to the top, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Best to enjoy the day it's made.
